newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to auction last rail concession on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to auction last rail concession on Friday.

text.p: A 30-year concession to operate the last of Brazil's six federal railway sections is to be auctioned Friday on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange at a base price of 11.5 million reais ($10.6 million).
The 2,924.4-mile (4,679 km) Northeast section links the states of Maranhao, Piaui, Ceara, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraiba, Pernambuco, Alagoas and Sergipe. It joins with the Center-East rail section.
Three consortia have "pre-qualified" to take part in the auction, scheduled for 1400 local time/1700 GMT Friday.
One of the consortia consists of steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica Nacional SA (CSN) and Companhia Vale do mining concern also known as CVRD.
A second consortium is led by Brazilian bank Interfinance in conjunction with Construbase, a Sao Paulo bus company. A third is composed of Brazil's MPE group and Eurobanco.
The president of the federal railway network, Isaac Popoutchi, said 60 million reais ($55.6 million) had been invested in the Northeast section to prepare it for privatization.
